name: Bison
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated in SIBO. Choose plain preparations without high-FODMAP seasonings or marinades.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like oregano, thyme, or rosemary
Cook with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Marinate with low-FODMAP ingredients like soy sauce, ginger, and citrus
Ground bison works well for burgers, meatballs, or chili
nutritionalHighlights: Leaner than beef with less saturated fat
Rich in vitamin B12 and zinc
